events.title: Cochin Carnival Week & Seaside Pageantry
events.note: Grand cultural carnival celebrating Fort Kochi's maritime heritage, music, vibrant street processions, and seaside gatherings.

events.title: Kochi-Muziris Biennale Contemporary Art Exhibition
events.note: Asia's largest contemporary art biennial showcasing site-specific installations, curated talks, and international artist pavilions across heritage warehouses.

events.title: Evening Kathakali Makeup Ritual & Classical Drama
events.note: Daily 5:00 PM natural mineral makeup demonstration followed by classical Mudra expressions and traditional Chenda drumming recital.

events.title: Cantilever Net Sunset Drops & Fishermen Gathering
events.note: Traditional 14th-century Chinese cantilever net teams demonstrate coordinated wooden beam counterweight drops during sunset tide.

events.title: Jew Town Spice Trading & Historic Antique Bazaar
events.note: Historic warehouse spice merchants sorting world-renowned Malabar black pepper, wild cardamom pods, and cinnamon quills.

events.title: Cathedral Basilica Evening Illumination & Choral Bells
events.note: Atmospheric evening illumination of the grand Portuguese-Gothic facade and historic ceiling frescoes.

events.title: Dhobi Khana Traditional Heritage Washing Demonstration
events.note: Century-old Vannar community demonstrating traditional stone-slab washing and heavy brass charcoal ironing techniques.

events.title: Historic Heritage Chimes & Vasco da Gama Memorial
events.note: Choral heritage chimes in India's oldest European church, preserving original timber gables and Vasco da Gama's 1524 burial marker.
